title: NexGo Taxi Standard (v0.2.0 draft)
description: Successor draft to nexgo-taxi.v0.1.0. A driver/vehicle REGISTRATION record only. Live GPS is REMOVED from the chain (it was infeasible at volume and a permanent public location-history hazard) -- real-time location moves to a direct encrypted p2p channel. Adds NAMESPACE driver identity, compliance-credential references (license/insurance), and a coarse 'service-area' geohash for p2p discovery. See docs/nexgo-cluster-design-note.md.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this asset's register address; referenced by ride-offers as 'vehicle'.

driver.description: Driver NAMESPACE (attestable), replacing the v0.1.0 free-text wallet/namespace string.

price-per-km-milli.description: Base price per km in milli-units of 'currency' (integer; divide by 1000). Replaces the v0.1.0 string price.

service-area.description: Coarse operating region as one or more pipe-separated geohash prefixes (e.g., 'u4pru|u4prv'). Used for p2p discovery, not precise location.

license-cred.description: self-addr of a namespace attestation/credential verifying the driver's license (issuer is the real-world authority; the chain stores the attestation).

loc-channel.description: Off-chain endpoint or pubkey for the driver's direct encrypted p2p live-location channel (e.g., a libp2p peer id). No coordinates are written on-chain.

examples._comment: Registered, available taxi -- no coordinates on-chain.

nexus.queryFilter: distordia-type = 'nexgo-taxi' AND status = 'available' AND service-area LIKE '{geohash}%'

notes: On-chain GPS removed: fixes the cost/throughput infeasibility AND the permanent public location-history privacy hazard. Live location is direct encrypted p2p (see loc-channel).
Driver compliance (license/insurance/KYC) is referenced as namespace credentials; the issuer is the irreducible real-world authority, the attestation lives on-chain.
Discovery is p2p on-chain via the coarse service-area geohash, not a central matcher.
Successor draft to nexgo-taxi.v0.1.0 (standards/nexgo-taxi-standard.json), retained for history.
